h: Zlatan Ibile's childhood friend Aloma ZTTW says how friends were treated at the singer's wedding
p: Aloma ZTTW, a childhood friend of singer Zlatan Ibile, has reportedly shared how he and other old friends were received at Zlatan's wedding. The wedding has drawn plenty of online talk, including questions about who attended.
more: Joke Jigan earlier asked why few Lagos socialites were present.
Zlatan has not publicly responded to the comments.
alt: Zlatan Ibile and Davita Lamai seated on thrones at their traditional wedding
